subject: design/implement-now-issue-entry
statement: Extend the skill with an issue branch and the Go command with mutually exclusive `--issue <native-number>` plus `--issue-input <file>` operands. The configured task binding selects the tracker instance and repository/root; a URL supplied to the skill must match that binding before conversion to a number. Plan mode remains its existing branch. Issue mode rejects plan operands, review-only operands, or missing paired issue/intake operands.
